findings.text: The original awk command `{ $0 ~ "pattern" }` never affects exit code - awk exits 0 on successful execution regardless of pattern match, so the URL validation was completely bypassed. The fix correctly uses `exit 1` to fail on non-matching input.

0.reason: The original awk command evaluates a match expression but never sets a non-zero exit status, so validation was bypassed; the fix correctly adds `exit 1`.
